steps.step: FP1.filtered CAR: {rho_x, rho_y^dag} = (F F^dag)_xy; without links F^2 has support {0, eps, eps+eps'} with 9/8, -1/4, 1/16 (2,0,0), 1/32 (2,2,0), 1/64 (2,2,2) (exact fractions); with random U(2) links the diagonal stays 9/8 and the support is unchanged
steps.detail: {rho, rho} = 0 trivially (rho is linear in psi)

steps.step: FP2.spectrum of F^2: f^2 in [0, 4]; null space = the k = 0 class only (one null momentum per cell, full rank elsewhere); smallest nonzero eigenvalue ~ L^-4; condition number bounded away from Gamma; normalised overlaps -2/9 (nearest), 1/18, 1/36, 1/72
steps.detail: null momenta per cell [1, 1, 1, 1]; min nonzero f^2 ~ L^-4.00; condition number for distance >= 0.5: 280.2, >= 1.0: 23.4

steps.step: FP3.cell geometry: a periodic primitive L^3 cell contains the mirror momentum P iff 4 | L (2^3, 3^3 do not, 4^3 does); a cubic box contains P iff its side is a multiple of 4 (the conventional 2^3 cubes with 16 sites do)
steps.detail: primitive 2^3 (8 sites): no; primitive 3^3 (27 sites): no; primitive 4^3 (64 sites): yes; cubic side 2 (2 sites): no; cubic side 4 (16 sites): yes; cubic side 6 (54 sites): no; cubic side 8 (128 sites): yes

steps.step: FP4.local spectrum by parity (canonical a = sqrt(8/9) rho, g* = 81/64 g): E_0 = -2176 g*; lowest even excitation 144 g* (x10), lowest odd 232 g* (x64), next even 320 g* (x54); even and odd sectors 2^31 each
steps.detail: gaps (in g*) and degeneracies: even (144.0, 10), odd (232.0, 64), next even (320.0, 54); in the original coupling: 729/4 g, 2349/8 g

steps.step: FP5.normal ordering: [Q, Q^dag] = 2 tr(M M^dag) - 4 a^dag (M^dag M) a (checked on a random 4-mode example), = 64 - 4N for the unitary B_A; hence H_int = H_quartic + 45 g sum psi^dag F^2 psi - 810 g N_sites; the extra one-particle term ~ f(k)^2 ~ |k|^4/4 at the light node; N conserved only mod 4

FP6.LOCAL_PATCH frustration: for b = r a + s c (r = -2/9) and any state whose a-factor has <a^dag a> = 1/2, <a a> = 0 (the unique singlet: Schur, Z4, <N-16> = 0), ||J_b Psi||^2 >= r^2 s^2 tr(t^2)/2 > 0: the two singlet minima are never reached simultaneously; E_min(h_x + h_y) > 2 E_0 (exact value of the 2^64 patch not computed)

FP7.(statement) the strong-coupling ground state is not a product of local singlets; the simple product proof of a mirror gap is excluded, the collective phase of the overlapping model decides Gate B (QMC / tensor networks after the sign audit)
